name: Lisa Taylor
note: About five months ago I blocked my brand of cigarettes from being sold to minors. It had been a problem for approx. 10 years and selling that brand is a better cigarette. But the clerk refused to take brand and insisted a card and driver’s license, then they were totally refused to sell them but didn’t have my registration receipt, so was unable to. I was very disappointed because cigarettes are so expensive and I had to just throw them away. Needless to say, I stopped buying cigarettes in that store. And just wanted to let someone know so this doesn’t happen to anyone else.
